messages:
aisha_cs: Heads-up — Orbit dedicated pool bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quota greenlit (1.2M tokens/day). Need final autoscale curve, circuit-breaker thresholds, and a one-page ops checklist for the customer. cc @marco_infra @devon_prod @riley_oncall
marco_infra: Copy. Send expected traffic shape and p95 target and I'll propose reactive + predictive scaling curves and queue fallback rules.
devon_prod: Traffic profile: steady ~130 RPS, short spikes to ~520 RPS (45-90s). p95 target <= 150ms. We recommend reserved=2xA100, burst pool=4xA100 auto-burst.
aisha_cs: Proposal summary: reserved_pool=2xA100; burst_pool=4xA100; daily_quota=1200000; p95<=150ms. Need model fallback plan and a quick customer ops checklist for graceful degradation.
marco_infra: Autoscale draft: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=16, metric=predicted_rps(using 5s MA)+gpu_util, target_util=65%, fast_scale_cooldown=20s. Circuit breaker: if queue_depth>500 OR avg_queue_ms>250ms for >20s -> route non-critical routes to compact variant and enable token-bucket reject for background jobs.
riley_oncall: I'll run a 20m soak + two 90s bursts tomorrow 10:15 PT. Quick locustfile (swap LOAD_TOKEN):
```python
from locust import HttpUser, task, between
class OrbitUser(HttpUser):
    wait_time = between(0.5, 1.0)
    @task
    def generate(self):
        self.client.post('/v1/generate', json={'input': 'load-probe'}, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer LOAD_TOKEN'})
```
infra-bot: loadtest scheduled: env=staging | job=orbit-bringup-2025-11-02 | start=2025-11-02T17:15:00Z | duration=00:20:00 | owner=riley_oncall
priya_am: Renewal note: Orbit's consumption trailed forecast last quarter. After the test let's package an enablement bundle (prefix caching, batching knobs, TTLs) and request a joint ops review with the customer. I can own outreach and a readiness checklist.
aisha_cs: Action items: 1) @marco_infra finalize autoscale + circuit-breaker rules and add predictive pre-warm step; 2) @devon_prod publish model fallback chain + cache key whitelist; 3) @riley_oncall run soak & paste metrics here; 4) @priya_am schedule customer ops review and prep one-pager. I'll update the bring-up runbook and attach canary routing.
devon_prod: Model fallback chain added to runbook: base-v3 -> compact-v2 -> micro-v1. Cache keys: user_prompt_template, system_prompt_hash. Expect ~30% token compute reduction on common flows.
riley_oncall: Warmup started in staging. Will post first-10m CPU/GPU and queue graphs here. Paging policy remains standard.
aisha_cs: Thanks team — this will help the customer ops handoff. I'll draft the short operator checklist after results and attach. :raised_hands:
